examples.arabic: عندما وصلت الى المحل تبادلت الحديث باحترام مع البائع الذي فهم موقفها
examples.english: When she arrived at the shop, she exchanged conversations with respect with the seller who understood her situation
examples.transliteration: Indama wasalat ila al-mahall tabadalat al-hadith bi-ihtiram ma'a al-ba'i' alladhi fahima mawqifaha

examples.arabic: شعرت مريم ببعض التردد قبل ان تعيد الفستان الى المحل
examples.english: Maryam felt some hesitation before returning the dress to the shop.
examples.transliteration: Sha'arat Maryam bi-ba'd at-taraddud qabl an tu'id al-fustan ila al-mahall.

examples.arabic: كان المحل مليئا بالعديد من الخيارات والازياء المتنوعة
examples.english: The shop was full of many choices and diverse styles.
examples.transliteration: Kāna al-maḥall malī'an bi-al-'adīd min al-khiyārāt wa-al-aziyā' al-mutanawwi'ah.

examples.english: I see a beautiful dress in the shop.

examples.arabic: امس اشترى احمد قبعة جديدة من محل كبير
examples.english: Yesterday Ahmed bought a new hat from a big shop.
examples.transliteration: Ams ishtara Ahmad qubba'atan jadidatan min mahallin kabir.
